description: SwiftUI source file defining the RootCanvas view for the iOS app, managing onboarding, gateway status, view routing, and UI components.

classes.name: RootCanvas.PresentedSheet
classes.description: Enumeration for the sheet states within RootCanvas (settings, chat, quickSetup).

classes.name: RootCanvas.StartupPresentationRoute
classes.description: Enumeration to determine startup presentation path (none, onboarding, settings).

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: Data model representing the state of the home canvas for UI rendering.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: Representation of individual agent cards shown on the home canvas.

classes.name: CanvasContent
classes.description: Subview managing core UI components and interaction overlays within RootCanvas.

classes.name: CameraFlashOverlay
classes.description: UIView overlay that visually indicates a camera flash via animated opacity.

methods.name: RootCanvas.startupPresentationRoute
methods.description: Determines the startup route for onboarding/settings based on device state.

methods.name: RootCanvas.shouldPresentQuickSetup
methods.description: Determines whether the quick setup sheet should be presented.

methods.name: RootCanvas.updateIdleTimer
methods.description: Enables or disables the device idle timer based on scene activity.

methods.name: RootCanvas.updateCanvasDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates debug status overlay based on current debug mode flags.

methods.name: RootCanvas.updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Encodes current home canvas state and updates the app model.

methods.name: RootCanvas.makeHomeCanvasPayload
methods.description: Constructs payload representing current app and gateway status for display.

methods.name: RootCanvas.resolveActiveAgentID
methods.description: Determines the currently active agent ID for display highlight.

methods.name: RootCanvas.resolveDefaultAgentID
methods.description: Gets the default agent ID for the gateway.

methods.name: RootCanvas.homeCanvasAgents
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of agent cards to display based on current active and default agents.

methods.name: RootCanvas.homeCanvasName
methods.description: Returns normalized display name for an agent.

methods.name: RootCanvas.homeCanvasBadge
methods.description: Generates badge (emoji or initials) for an agent.

methods.name: RootCanvas.normalized
methods.description: Utility to trim whitespace and check for empty string.

methods.name: RootCanvas.evaluateOnboardingPresentation
methods.description: Decides whether to show onboarding, settings, or do nothing, based on app state.

methods.name: RootCanvas.hasExistingGatewayConfig
methods.description: Checks if there is an existing valid gateway configuration.

methods.name: RootCanvas.maybeAutoOpenSettings
methods.description: Auto-opens the settings sheet if app determines it should.

methods.name: RootCanvas.maybeShowQuickSetup
methods.description: Displays the quick setup sheet if conditions are met.
